title: Living the Salafi Dawah in Your Community
description: What it means to be a Salafi in everyday life: belief, worship, community service and character - as taught by Abu Hakeem Bilal Davis. The complete 7-part series 'The Salafi Da'wah' (al-Salafiyoon), Salafi Publications / thesalafi. For anyone living in a non-Muslim or Muslim community seeking the straight path.
